connect_pybullet_gui: connect to the pybullet physics simulator in GUI mode using p.connect(p.GUI)
set_search_path: set an additional search path for pybullet data files using pybullet_data.getDataPath()
load_plugin: load a native plugin DLL into the pybullet simulation using p.loadPlugin()
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulation using p.loadURDF()
get_camera_image: render and retrieve a camera image from the pybullet simulation using p.getCameraImage()
